        ⚠ Pins show the town, not the exact spot. Likely and Worked out pins are not checked mines. Check licences with the Mining Cadastre Office before you pay.

        How to use

        • Pin colour = what is happening there.
        • Three groups: Verified — 46 · Likely — 914 · Worked out — 110.
        • Tap a pin or a place name to read about it.
        • Use search and filters to see only the places you want.

        Good to know

        • No licence areas, no amounts — only places, activity, and the newest checked news.
        • Likely places were not checked live. Weak ones say so on their page.
        • Worked out places claim nothing. Each page says what it was worked out from.

        On the map

        1,070 places — 46 Verified · 914 Likely · 110 Worked out — all 36 states + FCT.

        1,069 places have a full write-up.

        For information only

        Not money advice. Check everything yourself before you spend.
